# Copenhagen.com

> > Official Copenhagen city guide covering events, attractions, shopping, and practical visitor information for Denmark's capital.

Copenhagen.com serves as a comprehensive travel resource for visitors to Copenhagen, featuring event calendars powered by Ticketmaster, practical information about the city's infrastructure and demographics, shopping districts like Strøget, and connections to nearby Malmö via the Øresund Bridge.

## Key Topics

- Copenhagen events and tickets
- Ticketmaster integration
- Øresund Bridge to Malmö
- Copenhagen Fashion Week
- Strøget pedestrian zone
- Tivoli Gardens
- Bella Center venues
- Danish Krone (DKK) currency
- City Hall and landmarks
- Gallery Int Fashion Fair
- Copenhagen Fashion Festival
- Music festivals and culture
- Tourism and visitor services
- Denmark-Sweden connection
- Royal Academy of Music

## Essential Copenhagen Guide

- [Copenhagen City Guide](https://www.copenhagen.com/): Homepage: Copenhagen city guide for hotels, tours, Tivoli, and attractions
- [Copenhagen in brief](https://www.copenhagen.com/in-brief): Copenhagen overview: history, demographics, Øresund Bridge connection to Malmö
- [Practical information about Copenhagen](https://www.copenhagen.com/information): Practical visitor info: currency (DKK), emergency services, health insurance

## Events and Entertainment

- [Tickets and events in Copenhagen](https://www.copenhagen.com/events): Copenhagen events calendar featuring culture, music, sports via Ticketmaster

## Shopping and Districts

- [Shopping in Copenhagen](https://www.copenhagen.com/shopping): Shopping guide featuring Strøget pedestrian zone and Copenhagen malls
